5 تفرّج : see 7, in two places. ―
-b2- [It also signifies He diverted, amused, or cheered, himself; or became diverted, &c.; often followed by عَلَى شَىْءٍ, meaning by viewing a thing, i. e., some rare, or pleasing, object: but thus used, it is app. postclassical. (See also the next paragraph.)]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
